Relaxation and adventure await at our Blue Ocean Breeze in beautiful Highland Parks at Blue Mountain Beach, offering resort accommodations for up to 9 guests in 3 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms. On the first floor of the home, you will find an open concept main living space, made up of the living room, dining room, and fully equipped kitchen. Outside gas grill and porch with comfortable seating. Private balcony with a pristine view of the preserve and beautiful sunrises! Come and enjoy your stay on 30A!

Beach Access:
Blue Ocean Breeze and the Highland Parks Community are located approximately a 0.7 miles to convenient public beach access at Blue Mountain and 1.5 miles from the Gulf View Heights Beach Access, both having public restrooms.
Both also a short golf cart (or bike) ride away!

Pool Access:
Just a short stroll from the home lies the stunning Seasonally Heated Highland Parks community pool, which offers a collection of covered and uncovered seating areas, an outdoor kitchen, outdoor TV, waterfalls into the pool, a hot tub and a fire pit. The community pool area also has a four-story observation tower from which you can enjoy dazzling views of the Gulf of Mexico and surrounding Blue Mountain Beach. Seasonally heated March and April!

Enjoy our street-legal, 6-seater golf cart & 3 Adult Bicycles to cruise down 30A in Style!
Quick rides to the beach, Gulf Place, Seacrest, Seaside, Watercolor and more!
Enjoy a fun bicycle ride down 30A and to Blue Mountain Creamery for ice cream!

Granite counter-tops, stainless appliances and simple coastal decor are just a few of the features that make this home the perfect spot for your next family vacation! The living room offers comfortable, premium furnishings, while the dining area offers seating for 6 with additional seating for 3 at the breakfast bar. Dual Front and Back Porches and a covered Balcony are all great places to have your morning coffee, or your evening glass of wine, and the Back Patio (bordering the peaceful Nature Preserve) comes complete with a Propane Grill for Steak night!

Upstairs, you'll find a King Master Bedroom, with a Luxurious Walk-in Shower and Dual Vanities. You'll also find another King Bedroom and a Bunk Room for the Kids, complete with a Twin-over-Twin Bunk and Full Bed with a Twin Trundle. These Share a Second-floor Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo. Wall-mounted TV's in all bedrooms mean no fighting for remotes on this vacation!

This home is on our Resort Linen and Terry Package with guaranteed fresh linen and terry placed for every check in!

The community pool area also has a four-story observation tower from which you can enjoy dazzling views of the Gulf of Mexico and surrounding Blue Mountain Beach.

Beach Access:
Blue Ocean Breeze and the Highland Parks Community are located approximately a 0.7 miles to convenient public beach access at Blue Mountain and 1.5 miles from the Gulf View Heights Beach Access, both having public restrooms.
Both also a short golf cart (or bike) ride away!

The Neighborhood:
Named after the blue lupine flowers that grace its large sand dunes, the coastal village of Blue Mountain Beach lies between Grayton Beach and Gulf Place along the scenic 30A corridor. The village is known for its laid back attitude, locally owned boutiques, eclectic eateries, and boasts the highest views on 30A.

30A is a scenic stretch of highway down Florida's beautiful gulf coast between Destin and Panama City Beach. The highway connects the coastal villages of South Walton through the undisturbed beauty of rare dune lakes, sugar white sand, and emerald waters indigenous to the area. Each village has its own unique characteristics that paint a fairy tale like scene against some of the country's most beautiful beaches. Come live the 30A life and experience the beach the way it was meant to be, where Southern Charm meets Bohemian lifestyle and unforgettable vacation memories are created.

Nearby Attractions:
The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy!

Nearby Restaurants:
Local nearby restaurants include Pizza by the Sea, The Perfect Pig, Sunrise Coffee Co., Goatfeathers Seafood Market, Blue Mabel’s, Grayton Seafood Co, Blue Mountain Bakery, Local Catch Bar and Grill, Shunk Gulley, and Red Fish Taco.
